items.title: Tata Motors to launch Osprey SUV in South Africa in Q3 2026
items.summary: The compact SUV, sold as the Nexon in India, will enter the South African market under a new name and carry five-star NCAP safety credentials.

items.title: Tata Osprey Launch Confirmed For South Africa – Nexon Rebranded
items.summary: Tata Motors has confirmed that Nexon will be sold as the ‘Osprey’ in South Africa, with the launch scheduled for the third quarter of 2026 The post Tata Osprey Launch Confirmed For South Africa – Nexon Rebranded appeared first on RushLane .

items.title: JSW MG Motor lines up two new-energy SUVs for FY27 launch, plans ₹1,400 cr investment
items.summary: The company will introduce these 4.3-metre-plus models on its newly-unveiled multi-energy platform ADAPT that will be localised for the Indian market. The ₹1,400 crore investment commitment will support the upcoming product offensive and localisation roadmap.
